summary:
📋 Weekly Overseer Digest

⚠️ Both agents were blocked all cycle: the overseer's shared GitHub token returned 401 Bad credentials on every read/search/write call. crypto-trading, coachvision, and ufc-dashboard were NOT assessed — their true health is unknown until auth is fixed and the review is re-run.

Issues Found
- overseer — Shared GitHub token returns 401 "Bad credentials" on all tools (read, search, AND file_issue). Overseer is fully blind and cannot even file this bug via the normal path. Needs manual fix: rotate token, verify scopes (repo read + issues write), and add a startup auth pre-flight. (3 projects unreadable as a result.)

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. overseer — Per-tool credential preflight + graceful degradation with status badges (effort: low, impact: high): validate creds at run start and show per-project "available / auth failed / not configured" — directly prevents this week's silent whole-cycle blindness.
2. crypto-trading — Per-strategy risk-adjusted metrics (Sharpe, max drawdown, expectancy) in the daily log (effort: low, impact: high): compare strategies on risk, not just raw P&L; persist a JSON time series for trending.
3. overseer — Weekly digest notification via email/Discord (effort: low, impact: high): push the summary automatically instead of relying on visiting the dashboard, closing the pipeline loop.
4. ufc-dashboard — Odds-movement history with line-movement alerts (effort: medium, impact: high): persist timestamped odds snapshots, chart movement, flag notable movers past a probability threshold.
5. coachvision — Auto-generated per-session coaching highlight reel from key-technique + low-confidence frames (effort: medium, impact: medium): reuse existing detection timestamps to stitch clips for coaching and to spot where the model needs training data.

timeline.text_full: Looking at both reports, the core issue is a 401 authentication failure with the overseer's GitHub token, which prevented assessment of the three projects. The Bug-Hunter confirmed this single bug but couldn't file it, while the Idea Agent proposed five ideas — with the first one about credential preflight checking directly addressing the same root cause as the authentication failure. I'll merge these findings: the bug is the immediate problem, and idea #1 is the solution. I should rank the credential preflight check as the top enhancement since it directly prevents this week's failure mode. The other three projects showing "status unknown" aren't confirmed bugs, so I'll note them briefly alongside the overseer issue rather than listing them separately. For the final digest, I'll keep ideas 1 through 4 — they're all reasonable and distinct, even though ideas 1 and 3 both target the overseer. Dropping idea 5 keeps the phone-friendly format tight while preserving the most impactful suggestions.
